summary: Curaleaf filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices (AEMPS) approved registration of two standardized cannabis preparations (THC-dominant and CBD-dominant) under Royal Decree 903/2025. This is a regulatory milestone, not a special situation. There are no deal terms or financial terms. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or any other special-situation category. It is a routine regulatory update regarding product registration in Spain.
